title: Assistant Manager - SC Agro
description:
**Overview**
Responsible for driving Contract Farming (CF) operations across the Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram geography to ensure sustainable procurement of quality potatoes for Lay's and Uncle chips. The role is accountable for expanding the farmer base, strengthening procurement networks, managing storage operations, and ensuring uninterrupted supplies to manufacturing plants while building strategic partnerships with farmers, aggregators, cold storages, government agencies, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Lead the expansion and execution of Contract Farming programs across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Identify and develop new potato-growing clusters, multiplication pockets, and farmer networks to increase program penetration and ensure long-term supply sustainability.
* Drive seed sales, farmer enrolment, and adoption of recommended agronomic practices (POP) through regular field engagement.
* Ensure timely seed distribution, crop monitoring, and technical advisory to achieve quality and productivity targets.
* Strengthen relationships with farmers, aggregators, FPOs, cooperatives, and channel partners to improve farmer retention and program scalability.
* Procurement & Supply Assurance
* Own regional procurement targets for both Contract Farming (CF) and Non-Contract Farming (NCF) potatoes within approved commercial and quality specifications.
* Ensure uninterrupted month-wise and season-wise supply of potatoes from Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram to manufacturing plants.
* Monitor crop quality parameters including TPoD, solids, reducing sugars, and chip-grade specifications.
* Develop market intelligence on crop acreage, arrivals, pricing trends, competitor activities, and procurement opportunities to support commercial decision-making.
* Drive chip-grade procurement programs while ensuring quality compliance and minimizing pilferage.
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Identify, onboard, and manage strategic cold storage partners across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Lead long-storage planning, inventory monitoring, quality management, and phased evacuation to ensure uninterrupted plant supplies throughout the storage season.
* Work closely with storage operators, transport partners, and manufacturing teams to optimize inventory utilization and minimize storage losses.
* Stakeholder & Government Engagement
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Agriculture and Horticulture Departments, Mandi Boards, district administration, and other government agencies across Hooghly, West Midnapore & Jhargram.
* Partner with FPOs, cooperatives, research institutions, and local organizations to strengthen farmer engagement and expand Contract Farming initiatives.
* Organize farmer meetings, field demonstrations, extension programs, and government-led initiatives to enhance program visibility and adoption.
* Operational Excellence & Compliance
* Ensure compliance with company policies, procurement processes, statutory requirements, and documentation standards.
* Oversee seed sale documentation, procurement records, mandi tax compliance, transportation documentation, and audit readiness.
* Establish and monitor field quality laboratories, cook tests, and procurement quality protocols.
* Promote adoption of digital agriculture tools, satellite-based crop monitoring, precision farming, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure operational discipline among aggregators, transporters, cold storage partners, and suppliers.
* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Lead and develop the regional Agro team through coaching, mentoring, and technical capability building.
* Support implementation of an effective extension model to strengthen farmer connect and improve field execution.
* Foster a high-performance culture through structured reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Strategic & Sustainability Initiatives
* Drive sustainability initiatives including Sustainable farming practices (SFP), regenerative agriculture, and other resource-efficient farming practices across the region.
* Support R&D initiatives involving new potato varieties, agronomic practices, crop protection molecules, and field demonstrations.

**Qualifications**
Experience & Qualifications
  
  
Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in agriculture (B.Sc. Agriculture) is preferable.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Agriculture, Agribusiness, Marketing, or Supply Chain is preferred.

**Experience**

* 6–8 years of experience in Contract Farming, agricultural procurement, agri-input sales, or agri-supply chain management.
* Strong experience working with potato farming ecosystems, cold storage operations, and farmer engagement in North Bengal, Bihar, or similar geographies.
* Demonstrated ability to manage government stakeholders, FPOs, traders, transporters, and cold storage partners.
* Proven leadership skills with experience in leading field teams and driving regional business outcomes.

Key Competencies
  
  

* Contract Farming Development
* Farmer & Aggregator Relationship Management
* Potato Procurement & Market Intelligence
* Cold Storage & Inventory Management
* Commercial Negotiation
* Government & Institutional Liaison
* Supply Chain Planning & Execution
* Team Leadership & Capability Development
* Data Analytics & Digital Agriculture
* Sustainability & Regenerative Agriculture

Problem Solving & Execution Excellence

title: Assistant General Manager (CDL)
description:
****Assistant General Manager – Shuttle Operations (CDL Required)****
**LAZ Airport Services | Full-Time | Leadership | CDL Required**
****Lead Operations. Develop Leaders. Drive the Future of Transportation.****
At LAZ Parking, our people are the foundation of our success. As the Assistant General Manager (AGM) of Shuttle Operations, you will play a critical leadership role in supporting one of the region's largest transportation operations.
  
  
This position partners with the General Manager to oversee operational performance, employee engagement, safety, financial results, and customer satisfaction across a complex shuttle transportation environment. You will lead managers, supervisors, and frontline employees while driving operational excellence and ensuring a safe, reliable, and customer-focused transportation experience.
  
  
Whether you are looking to expand your transportation leadership experience, strengthen your operational expertise, or take the next step toward executive-level leadership, LAZ Parking offers an opportunity to make a meaningful impact every day.
  
  
****Why Join LAZ?****

* Senior leadership opportunity within a growing national organization
* Opportunity to influence business strategy and operational performance
* Exposure to large-scale transportation and airport operations
* Career growth and advancement opportunities
* Collaborative, people-first leadership culture
* Opportunity to develop future leaders and strengthen organizational talent
* Dynamic environment where no two days are the same
* PayActiv, access earned wages before payday
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Health coaching and wellness resources
* Employee recognition and development programs

****Full-Time Benefits****

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Short-Term Disability Coverage
* Long-Term Disability Coverage
* Life Insurance Options

****About LAZ Parking****
LAZ Parking is one of the largest and fastest-growing parking and transportation management companies in the country. Our transportation operations help move millions of passengers annually through airport, commercial, and shuttle transportation services.
  
  
Our success is built on operational excellence, customer service, strong partnerships, and investing in our people. We believe in promoting from within, developing future leaders, and creating opportunities for employees to build long-term careers.
  
  
At LAZ, parking is our industry, but people are our passion.
  
  
****Schedule & Work Environment****
This position supports a large-scale transportation operation that functions seven days a week and may require schedule flexibility, including mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, emergency response situations, and operationally critical events.
  
  
The Assistant General Manager regularly works throughout transportation facilities, maintenance areas, operational offices, airport environments, and customer-facing locations while interacting with employees, stakeholders, clients, and regulatory agencies.
  
  
****The Spirit of the Position****
As an Assistant General Manager, you are a strategic leader, operational expert, and people developer.
  
  
You understand that successful transportation operations require strong leadership, disciplined execution, exceptional customer service, and an unwavering commitment to safety. Through your leadership, business acumen, and operational expertise, you help create an environment where employees can perform at their best while ensuring the organization delivers outstanding service, financial results, and operational performance.
  
  
You bring professionalism, accountability, innovation, and a solutions-oriented mindset to every challenge.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
****Strategic Leadership****

* Partner with the General Manager to develop and execute operational and business strategies.
* Identify opportunities for growth, service enhancement, and operational improvement.
* Develop and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) related to service, safety, financial performance, and customer satisfaction.
* Support organizational change initiatives and operational transformation efforts.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives designed to enhance efficiency and service delivery.

****Operational Leadership****

* Oversee daily shuttle transportation operations, including fleet utilization, route management, staffing, and resource allocation.
* Analyze operational performance data to identify trends and improvement opportunities.
* Develop contingency and recovery plans to address operational disruptions.
* Ensure transportation services are delivered safely, efficiently, and consistently.
* Support implementation of technology solutions and operational best practices.
* Drive operational excellence through performance measurement, accountability, and process improvement.

****People Leadership & Development****

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop managers, supervisors, and frontline employees.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, inclusion, and service excellence.
* Support succession planning and leadership development initiatives.
* Conduct performance evaluations, coaching conversations, and talent assessments.
* Promote employee engagement, retention, and workforce development programs.
* Build high-performing teams focused on achieving organizational goals.

****Safety, Compliance & Risk Management****

* Ensure compliance with all applicable DOT, OSHA, federal, state, local, airport, and company regulations.
* Lead safety initiatives and reinforce a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
* Support audits, inspections, regulatory reviews, and compliance assessments.
* Identify operational risks and implement mitigation strategies.
* Maintain accurate records, documentation, and compliance reporting.
* Support incident investigations and corrective action efforts when necessary.

****Customer Experience & Stakeholder Relations****

* Champion a customer-first culture that promotes exceptional service delivery.
* Support the development of customer experience initiatives and service enhancements.
* Serve as a key partner to clients, airport stakeholders, vendors, government agencies, and community partners.
* Assist with escalated customer concerns and service recovery efforts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships that support long-term operational success.

****Financial & Administrative Leadership****

* Assist with budget development, forecasting, and financial planning activities.
* Monitor labor, operational, maintenance, and administrative expenses.
* Analyze financial and operational performance metrics.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency while maintaining service standards.
* Support revenue growth, cost management, and profitability objectives.
* Oversee vendor relationships and support procurement activities when necessary.

****Team & Operational Excellence****

* Partner closely with the General Manager to align operational objectives with organizational strategy.
* Support market growth, new business opportunities, transitions, and special projects.
* Promote LAZ Parking's mission, values, and culture throughout the operation.
* Drive innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Perform other duties and leadership responsibilities as assigned.

****Who You Are****
****Strategic Thinker****
You can translate organizational goals into actionable plans and measurable results.
  
  
****Operational Leader****
You understand complex transportation operations and can balance efficiency, service, safety, and financial performance.
  
  
****People Developer****
You enjoy coaching leaders, developing talent, and building high-performing teams.
  
  
****Business-Minded****
You understand financial performance, operational metrics, budgeting, and long-term business sustainability.
  
  
****Collaborative Communicator****
You build strong relationships across all levels of an organization and with external stakeholders.
  
  
****Customer Advocate****
You are passionate about delivering exceptional service and creating positive customer experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications Required**

* Valid CDL and ability to maintain required driving qualifications.
* Minimum of 3 years of progressive leadership experience in transportation, logistics, shuttle operations, or a related industry.
* Minimum of 3 years of leadership experience managing supervisors, managers, or large operational teams.
* Strong knowledge of transportation operations, fleet management, safety programs, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience managing operational performance metrics and business objectives.
* Excellent communication, leadership, coaching, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and operational reporting systems.

****Preferred****

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Transportation Management, Logistics, or a related field.
* Airport transportation or shuttle operations experience.
* Experience managing large-scale or multi-site transportation operations.
* Experience supporting collective bargaining agreements or unionized workforces.
* Experience with fleet management systems, transportation technologies, and data analytics tools.
* Experience leading organizational change and operational transformation initiatives.

****Physical Requirements****
**This Position Requires The Ability To**

* Work both indoors and outdoors in varying weather conditions.
* Stand and walk for extended periods.
* Travel throughout transportation facilities, operational locations, and airport environments.
* Lift, push, and pull up to 25 pounds.
* Bend, stoop, squat, and move frequently throughout the workday.
* Safely enter and exit transportation vehicles when operational support is required.
* Communicate effectively in person, by phone, radio, video conference, and email.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.
  
  
****Lead People. Drive Performance. Shape the Future.****
If you are passionate about transportation leadership, operational excellence, employee development, and delivering exceptional customer experiences, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Join LAZ Airport Services and help lead a world-class transportation operation while developing the next generation of operational leaders.**
**FLSA Status:**
Non-Exempt
  
  
LAZ Parking is an Equal Opportunity Employer and participates in E-Verify. Equal employment opportunities are provided to all employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Senior Manager - SC Quality Control
description:
**Overview**
This role will provide technical and Quality & Food Safety leadership for Foods business and help delivering AMESA sector QC vision
  
  
“Drive Quality and Food safety Excellence to delight our consumers and customers.”
  
  
Responsible to ensure food safety plans and policies in the business unit are in alignment with PI and PepsiCo policies and strategies.
  
  

* Develop and execute food safety strategies and plans in alignment with the Business Unit Strat Plan and in alignment with the PepsiCo Food Safety Policies.
* Ensure food safety requirements are fully understood throughout the BU manufacturing sites and provide training of all pertinent PI requirements and best practices around food safety.

Provide SME support to the business unit to maintain safe processes and products within the current portfolio and with future innovation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute food safety strategies and plans in alignment with the India business unit Strat Plan and in alignment with the PepsiCo Food Safety Policies.
* Ensure food safety requirements are fully understood throughout the BU and manufacturing sites.
* Provide training of all pertinent PI requirements and best practices around food safety,
* Assist in troubleshooting and SME support efforts for products and processes.
* Ensure HACCP Plans are in place and effective in the site.
* Ensure allergen management programs are in place where needed and is assessed.
* Ensure traceability of ingredients, materials and finished product is effective and the tracking can be accomplished in a timely manner.
* Ensure the business unit is capable to meet food safety requirements in terms of people, infrastructure, and process/building designs.
* Assist in resolving any capability issues in a timely fashion
* Continually assess this capability in light of new product/process/package innovation initiatives.
* Continually assess and identify systematic issues found in Food Safety audits and ensure improvement actions are developed in a timely manner.
* Ensure appropriate water and ingredient tests are conducted and results meet the specified requirements for food safety; take immediate corrective actions where deviations occur.
* Ensure appropriate finished product tests are conducted and results meet the specified requirements for food safety as directed by Support Center and/or government regulations.
* Ensure appropriate information is provided to enable an accurate measurement of food safety for BU within the 3D Quality program.
* Compliance to FSSAI requirements and nominee for FSSAI for Plant and WH/ CFA.

**Qualifications**

* At least a bachelor’s degree in science or engineering with a strong understanding of Foods manufacturing
* Functional Experience: Approx. 5 – 7 years of experience and proven track record managing food safety within food manufacturing operations
* At least 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience in a FMCG industry (preferably food industry)

Lead auditor certification in food safety management systems (ISO 22K, FSSC 22K) would be preferred
  
  
**Differentiating Competencies Required**

* Sound knowledge for foods manufacturing process and quality management
* Ability to work effectively and efficiently with teams
* Ability to manage multiple stake holders (internal and external) and multitasking
* Ability to lead team of professionals and operators
* Ability to work effectively and manage risk in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity and change
* Ability to manage conflict, using data and influencing skills to drive decisions

title: Leder til Skovbørnehaven Alfely
description:
Vi er en lille, Steiner-inspireret skovbørnehave med 22 børn og 4 ansatte, som søger en ny, praksisnær leder. Du vil hovedsageligt deltage i det pædagogiske arbejde samt varetage ledelses- og administrative opgaver ca. 8-10 timer ugentligt.
  
  
Vores unikke skovbørnehave ligger naturskønt under træerne med Vestskoven som baghave og Albertslund Rideskole som nabo.
  
  
Her får du naturen som arbejdsplads og tid til kvalitet i det pædagogiske arbejde.
  
  
Bliv leder hos os
  
  
Vi søger et engageret, fleksibelt og kærligt menneske med lyst til at videreføre børnehavens livsnerve: natur og udeliv, rytme, sanselige oplevelser, efterligning, leg, fællesskaber, eventyr og årstidsfester.
  
  
**Hos Os Får Du**

* Nærvær: Du får tid til fordybelse i børnerelateret arbejde. Du indgår i børnehavens pædagogiske og praktiske hverdag.
* Natur: Du får en hverdag under åben himmel i vores skønne have og den omkringliggende vilde natur, hvor årstidernes skiften er en naturlig del af pædagogikken.
* Kultur: Du leder og udvikler børnehaven i samarbejde med personalet og bestyrelsen med afsæt i vores fælles værdier og traditioner.
* Administrativ støtte: Du samarbejder med Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner (LDD), som understøtter dine administrative og økonomiske opgaver.
* Faglig udvikling: Vi prioriterer din udvikling og tilbyder løbende relevante kurser gennem LDD. Efter ønske er der mulighed for mentorordning.

En børnehave med udeliv og eventyr
  
  
Vi er inspireret af Steiner-pædagogikken, hvor sang, eventyr og årstidsfester skaber en genkendelig og tryg rytme for børnene.
  
  
Vi passer haven, laver mad over bål, går på ture og opdagelse i skoven. Vi graver og bygger i sandkassen og mudderhullet. Vi sår og høster i køkkenhaven og leger i regn, blæst og sol.
  
  
**Vores Pædagogiske Tilgang Bygger På**

* Tryghed gennem gentagelser og faste rytmer
* Læring gennem efterligning og sanselige oplevelser
* Fokus på relationer, fællesskab og respekt for det enkelte barn
* Målrettet styrkelse af børnenes selvstændighed og selvhjulpenhed

Dine opgaver som leder
  
  

* Personaleledelse, personalemøder og skemaplanlægning
* Planlægning og evaluering af den pædagogiske indsats, bl.a. pædagogiske aktiviteter, ugeplaner og årshjul i samarbejde med personalet
* Administrative opgaver samt samarbejde med børnehavens bestyrelse
* Deltagelse i og medansvar for det praktiske pædagogiske arbejde

Hvem er du?
  
  

* Er uddannet pædagog eller har tilsvarende relevant baggrund
* Har gerne erfaring med personaleledelse
* Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket
* Er god til at samarbejde og kommunikere med personale, forældre, bestyrelse og andre instanser
* Er tydelig og anerkendende i din kommunikation
* Har høje pædagogiske ambitioner

Praktisk information
  
  

* Jobbet er på fuld tid med ansættelse den 1. november 2026 eller snarest derefter.
* Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst mellem LDD og BUPL.
* Der indhentes børneattest og referencer i forbindelse med ansættelse.
* Børnehavens åbningstid er 7.15-17.00.
* Børnehaven er privat, og børnehavens øverste ledelse er bestyrelsen, der består af forældrevalgte repræsentanter.
* Børnehaven administreres af LDD, der ligeledes assisterer os med ansættelsen.

Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte leder Lene André på tlf. 2877 1014.
  
  
Vil du se mere om vores dejlige institution, kan du se mere i videoen her og læse mere på vores hjemmeside www.alfely.dk.
  
  
**Ansøgningsfrist:**
9. november 2026.
  
  
Samtaler afholdes løbende.
  
  
**Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og modtage din ansøgning.**

description:
It's about Being What's next.
**What's in it for you?**
The Manager Business Consulting will act as a business-facing IT partner by managing the application lifecycle and providing effective post-implementation support for Sales and Supply processes across the RSE region
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
  
  
Every day is an opportunity: an opportunity to learn, to grow, to share success, and to contribute to one of the world’s leading industrial gas and engineering companies. Seize the opportunity: take your next step with us and join our team.
  
  
Linde values diversity and recognizes the importance of fostering inclusion in our work environment. We believe that our success depends on the diverse perspectives of our employees, customers, and global markets. As an employer of choice, we strive to support our employees' growth, welcome new ideas, and respect our differences.
  
  
Team
  
  

Making an impact.
**What will you do?**

* In this role you will participate as a core project team member in the implementation of SAP and non-SAP applications, including system interfaces, across the RSE region
* Further you will own the application development lifecycle for assigned initiatives by working with business users to gather and document requirements, translating them into SAP process designs, developing the functional specifications, configuring SAP solutions, collaborating closely with ABAP developers for custom developments, performing system testing, supporting user acceptance test and ensuring successful deployment.
* Furthermore, you will identify process gaps and propose workarounds where required
* Moreover, you will provide end-to-end SAP application support for Sales and Supply systems across the relevant modules (e.g. SD, MM/PP/PM, Procurement, SAP authorisations, integrated FI/CO areas), including issue troubleshooting, user training, data cleansing and post go-live support
* Further you will maintain accurate and up-to-date system documentation, including business requirements, solution designs, configuration details and user/training manuals
* Moreover, you will act as a business process specialist by maintaining a strong understanding of Sales and Supply processes including OTC, PTP, R2R and master data management
* Additionally, you will collaborate with Global IT teams (including GIMS, BASIS, Release Management, TCOE, Global Business Consulting), Shared Services, regional and country IT teams, and external vendors to ensure successful project delivery and support

Winning in your role.
**Do you have what it takes?**

* For this role you will have a degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or other disciplines with strong interest in business consulting and a solid understanding of IT and business applications
* Further you have a minimum of 3 years’ experience in system implementations, particularly in SAP SD
* Furthermore, you have a strong business knowledge and understanding of Sales and Supply processes
* Additionally, you have the ability to work in a global environment and travel as required

**Why you will love working for us!**
Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company, operating in more than 100 countries worldwide. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.
  
  
On the 1st of April 2020, Linde India Limited and Praxair India Private Limited successfully formed a joint venture, LSAS Services Private Limited. This company will provide Operations and Management (O&M) services to both existing organizations, which will continue to operate separately. LSAS carries forward the commitment towards sustainable development, championed by both legacy organizations. It also takes ahead the tradition of the development of processes and technologies that have revolutionized the industrial gases industry, serving a variety of end markets including chemicals & refining, food & beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, and primary metals.
  
  
At Linde, the sky is not the limit. If you’re looking to build a career where your work reaches beyond your job description and betters the people with whom you work, the communities we serve, and the world in which we all live, at Linde, your opportunities are limitless. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
  
  
Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!
  
  
We are looking forward to receiving your complete application (motivation letter, CV, certificates) via our online job market.
  
  
Any designations used of course apply to persons of all genders. The form of speech used here is for simplicity only.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other reason prohibited by applicable law.
  
  
Linde South Asia Services Pvt. Ltd. acts responsibly towards its shareholders, business partners, employees, society and the environment in every one of its business areas, regions and locations across the globe. The company is committed to technologies and products that unite the goals of customer value and sustainable development.

title: Daglig leder til Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave
description:
Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave er en hyggelig privat institution med omkring 20 dejlige skovbørn, hvor der er masser af hjertevarme, glæde og fællesskab.
   

  

 Institutionen blev grundlagt i 1970 og har i dag base i Stenløse Egedal Kommune. Hver dag, året rundt kører vi på eventyr i skov og ved strand i vores trofaste bus ”Rumle”. Vi bruger alt vores tid ude, og vores mål er at lære børnene at færdes i naturen, vise dem hvor givende naturen er, med bl.a. læring om respekt for dyr og plantelivet.
   

  

 Nærvær og indlevelse, glæde og latter er det centrale omdrejningspunkt i vores hverdag. Vi sætter en ære i at alle har haft en god dag, når de går hjem.
   

  

 Du vil blive leder for en dynamisk og engageret personalegruppe med hver deres kompetencer, som har et tæt samarbejde – både blandt hinanden, men også med forældregruppen og bestyrelsen. Vores værdier og menneskesyn udspringer af anerkendelse og respekt over for hinanden – store som små, og at møde barnet der hvor det er, og bidrage til selvværd og selvudvikling hos det enkelte barn. Vi bruger alle rammerne i naturen til at skabe læring, sjov og glæde. Vi har særlig fokus på leg, bevægelse, kreativitet og sociale fællesskaber samt børneyoga og mindfulness.
   

  

 Personaleledelse, administration og samarbejde
   

  

 Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave består af en personalegruppe på 4 personer og mellem 20 og 30 skønne skovbørn. Du skal have overblik, være struktureret og god til at samarbejde. Jobbet indebærer en række administrative opgaver, herunder budgetansvar, ugeplanlægning, ventelistehåndtering, opfølgning, personale\- og forældresamtaler, svare henvendelser på mail og telefon mv. Økonomi og administration vil foregå i tæt dialog med bestyrelsen og Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner – LDD som vi er medlem af.
   

  

 Arbejdet vil være fordelt således, at der i gennemsnit er 2 faste dage om ugen til kontor og de resterende dage er du med i skoven.
   

  

 Profil
   

  

* Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring ledelse fra tidligere job.
* Du skal kunne lide at færdes i naturen og har flair for udelivet.
* Du har økonomisk overblik, arbejder struktureret og har it\-forståelser.
* Du skal kunne bevæge dig i krydsfeltet mellem at være på børn og være leder.
* Du besidder empati og kan skabe tryghed og omsorg for det enkelte barn og gruppen som helhed.
* Du kan udvise ansvarlighed overfor børnehavens værdier og koncept.
* Du kan samarbejde med åben dialog, forståelse og tydelig kommunikation.
* Du kan inspirere og er god til sparring og opbygge et positivt samarbejdsklima.


 Vi søger dig, som har lyst til at indgå i et spændende og givende job, hvor du vil få stor indflydelse på, at vores børn får den bedste start på livet ved at gå i en skovbørnehave.
   

  

 Stillingen er på 37 timer og til besættelse snarest muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Frist for ansøgning er 14\. oktober 2026\.
   

  

 Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du ringe til vores formand Cecilie Wium\-Tellefsen på 28 15 95 13\.
   

  

 Din ansøgning sendes til formand@skovboernehave.dk, og du bedes vedhæfte CV, uddannelsespapirer, kursusbeviser, udtalelser, referencer og/eller andre relevante papirer.
   

  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Shift In-charge - Power Plant
description:
**Shift In\-Charge – Power Plant** 




**Company:** 
 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd.
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Power Generation / Captive Power Plant
 



**Location:** 
 Jharkhand, India
 



**Experience:** 
 5–7 Years
 



**Qualification:** 
 B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering
 



 Job Summary
 



 IMP Engineering \& Power Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced
 **Shift In\-Charge** 
 to supervise the day\-to\-day operation of a
 **Captive Power Plant** 
 . The candidate will be responsible for ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient plant operation during the assigned shift, coordinating operating teams, monitoring equipment performance, and achieving operational targets.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Supervise complete shift operations of the power plant, including
 **Boiler, Turbine, CHP, and associated auxiliaries** 
 .
* Monitor operating parameters through
 **DCS/control room and field operations** 
 and take appropriate corrective action.
* Coordinate with Boiler, Turbine, Electrical, CHP, WTP, and Maintenance teams for smooth plant operation.
* Ensure safe start\-up, shutdown, load changes, and emergency handling as per established operating procedures.
* Monitor boiler and turbine performance and maintain stable plant load and operating conditions.
* Coordinate with maintenance teams for equipment abnormalities, breakdowns, and planned maintenance activities.
* Ensure proper coal/fuel handling and availability of required utilities during the shift.
* Maintain shift logs, operational records, generation reports, and equipment performance data.
* Ensure compliance with plant safety procedures, statutory requirements, and company operating standards.
* Supervise operators and technicians and ensure proper manpower deployment during the shift.
* Identify operational problems and coordinate troubleshooting to minimize downtime.
* Conduct shift handovers and communicate critical plant conditions and pending activities to the incoming shift team.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* **4\-5 years minimum of relevant experience** 
 in Thermal Power Plant / Captive Power Plant / Co\-Generation Plant operations.
* Strong practical knowledge of
 **Boiler and Turbine operations** 
 .
* Experience in
 **DCS\-based plant operation** 
 will be preferred.
* Good understanding of plant auxiliaries, CHP, electrical systems, and utility systems.
* Ability to lead and coordinate shift manpower effectively.
* Strong troubleshooting, decision\-making, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of industrial safety practices and operational procedures.



 Qualification
 



**B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline.** 
 Candidates with relevant experience in captive, co\-generation, sugar, distillery, or process\-industry power plants will be considered.
 



 Immediate Requirement
 



**Immediate joiners / candidates with short notice periods will be preferred.** 




**Interested candidates can apply with their updated CV.** 




**Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹42,000\.00 per month** 




**Benefits:** 



* Health insurance
* Provident Fund
* Work Location: In person



  





 Apply now or send your CV to hr@impepl.com \| hr.corporate@impepl.com

title: Cleaning Specialist II
description:
**Description**
 The Portland Area Manager will play a crucial role in managing our janitorial teams across various sites, ensuring that all cleaning and maintenance tasks meet our high standards of quality and efficiency. This position requires a balance of leadership, customer service, and operational expertise, as well as a commitment to health and safety protocols.
   

  

 Technical Skills
   

  

* Oversee the daily operations of janitorial services across multiple locations, ensuring all standards of cleanliness and maintenance are met or exceeded.
* Manage, train, and develop a team of janitors and supervisors, promoting a culture of high performance, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
* Conduct regular site inspections and audits to assess the quality of work performed, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions as necessary.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and ensuring their satisfaction with our services.
* Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations, promoting a safe working environment for all employees.
* Manage inventory of cleaning supplies and equipment, ensuring that teams have the necessary resources to perform their duties effectively.
* Prepare and manage budgets for janitorial operations, including labor costs, supplies, and equipment maintenance.
* Address and resolve any issues or complaints from clients or staff promptly and professionally.
* Implement and monitor sustainability practices in cleaning methods and products.
* Prepare reports and analyses on operational activities, performance metrics, and other relevant data for senior management.

description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION

 LOCATION : Branch

**Direct Reporting**
* BDE/AAM/AM
* BSM/CA\-AM
* Dotted line reporting of certain Silver \& Gold Branch Heads

* ROLE PURPOSE \& OBJECTIVE
* This role is responsible for driving the entire business targets for liabilities assigned to the branch; Manage exceptional customer service, proactive sales environment and efficient branch operations, while adhering to regulations/compliance requirements; Focus on retaining existing customers, increasing the customer base and cross\-selling Ujjivan’s products and services; Oversee branch operations, cash management and service quality; work closely with product and marketing teams to drive campaigns at their branches.

* CA

**Business**
* Implement branch specific marketing \& communication strategies to continuously strengthen the Ujjivan brand.

* Manage exceptional customer service, proactive sales environment and efficient branch operations, while adhering to regulations/compliance requirements
* Focus on retaining existing customers, increasing the customer base and cross\-selling Ujjivan’s products and services
